row.name: Callous
row.description: You are merciless, if not cruel. You decipher others’ emotions, but only to manipulate them. You do not care about feelings, or pain. Gives you -3 on all Teaching rolls, on Psychology rolls made to help others (as opposed to deduce weakness or conduct scientific research), and on any roll made to interact with those who have suffered the consequences of your callousness in the past (GM decision). As well, past victims, and anyone with Empathy, will react to you at -1. You get an extra +1 to Interrogation and Intimidation rolls when you use threats or torture.
